od = flows %>%
  group_by(origin_zone = origin, dest_zone = dest) %>%
  summarise(flow = sum(flow), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(origin_zone != dest_zone)

kept = od %>%
  filter(flow >= 100) %>%
  arrange(desc(flow))

kept %>%
  summarise(pairs_kept = n(), flow_kept = sum(flow), share_kept = sum(flow) / sum(od$flow))

kept %>% slice_head(n = 20)  # the corridors drawn on the map
code.sql:
WITH od AS (
  SELECT origin AS origin_zone, dest AS dest_zone, SUM(flow) AS flow
  FROM flows
  WHERE origin <> dest
  GROUP BY origin, dest
)
SELECT origin_zone, dest_zone, flow
FROM od
WHERE flow >= 100
ORDER BY flow DESC;

od = flows %>%
  group_by(origin_zone = origin, dest_zone = dest) %>%
  summarise(flow = sum(flow), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(origin_zone != dest_zone)

# net flow: subtract the reverse corridor (a self-join)
od = od %>%
  left_join(od, by = c("origin_zone" = "dest_zone", "dest_zone" = "origin_zone"),
            suffix = c("", "_back")) %>%
  mutate(flow = flow - coalesce(flow_back, 0)) %>%
  filter(flow > 0) %>%
  select(origin_zone, dest_zone, flow)

kept = od %>%
  filter(flow >= 100) %>%
  arrange(desc(flow))

kept %>%
  summarise(pairs_kept = n(), flow_kept = sum(flow), share_kept = sum(flow) / sum(od$flow))

kept %>% slice_head(n = 20)  # the corridors drawn on the map
code.sql:
WITH od AS (
  SELECT origin AS origin_zone, dest AS dest_zone, SUM(flow) AS flow
  FROM flows
  WHERE origin <> dest
  GROUP BY origin, dest
),
net AS (
  SELECT a.origin_zone, a.dest_zone, a.flow - COALESCE(b.flow, 0) AS flow
  FROM od a
  LEFT JOIN od b ON a.origin_zone = b.dest_zone AND a.dest_zone = b.origin_zone
  WHERE a.flow - COALESCE(b.flow, 0) > 0
)
SELECT origin_zone, dest_zone, flow
FROM net
WHERE flow >= 100
ORDER BY flow DESC;
